name: MotoBros - Punta Gorda MX
tracks_on_site: main MX/SX-style track (lit for night riding)

soil.notes: One directory calls the surface a blend of hard pack and sand. The site is the former 4-17 Southern Speedway oval property beside Punta Gorda Airport, converted to motocross by MotoBros in 2023; only one source describes the dirt, so treat as unconfirmed.

layout.notes: Operator describes the main track as a cross between supercross and motocross. Directories mention well-built tabletops, rhythm sections and ruts. Elevation is 'flat' only in the sense that the site is a former speedway on flat coastal land; jumps are man-made.

conditions.watering_prep: Directories say the crew waters and grooms between sessions to hold traction through the day.
conditions.seasonal: Night riding under lights on selected evenings; hosts the MotoBros Night Shift series and Florida Series rounds (e.g. round 12, Nov 2024). Heat and limited shade noted by visitors.

rider_reports.says: Operator post in a Florida track thread: two tracks, main one lit for night riding and pitched as a supercross/motocross blend; a reply put the gate at about $50 per rider.
A January 2026 reviewer raised safety concerns: flaggers using phones instead of radios and no medic or ambulance on site during their visit.

name: MotoBros - Okeechobee MX
tracks_on_site: MX track 2 (the two main tracks alternate every 15 minutes)

soil.notes: Several listings agree it is mainly sand with some clay mixed in, enough to hold a rut and groom up well; one rider-oriented blog calls it deep sand, and an older RiderPlanet entry calls it loamy with sand and clay plus a few hard-packed spots.

layout.notes: Main track has a roller section, step-ups, tabletops and a built-up hill big enough to scrub off. Described as fast for advanced riders while still usable by beginners. About 22 acres of track area on flat ranch land.

conditions.dry: Deep, loose sand expected when dry; rewards technique and momentum over horsepower.
conditions.late_day: Sand-clay mix reportedly holds ruts, so expect lines to deepen through the day.
conditions.watering_prep: Listings describe the tracks as regularly groomed.
conditions.seasonal: Practice Wednesday-Sunday; private rentals Monday-Tuesday; membership (day or annual) required on top of gate fee.

rider_reports.says: Operator post: three tracks plus pro shop, beach and RV hookups; a reply called Okeechobee (and Bostwick) a must-ride.
A Miami rider described Thundercross, about two hours north, as legit.
Southeast track roundup describes deep sand, big jumps and a remote ranch-country setting that rewards technique.

name: Miami Motocross Park
tracks_on_site: main track (about half a mile, lit, starting gate)

soil.notes: Built in a former mining pit on the edge of the Everglades off Krome Ave. A 2022 magazine piece says the owner waters and dozes the lanes to keep a firm, hard-packed surface; RiderPlanet instead lists mostly loose dirt with some sand. Likely crushed limerock/fill typical of Dade pits, but no source names limerock, so unconfirmed.

layout.notes: Main track is roughly half a mile with many berms, plus small and larger jumps and built-up hills. Only motocross track in Miami-Dade; the only one in the Miami/Fort Lauderdale metro since Air Dania closed.

conditions.dry: Watered to stay hard and firm; little shade on track.
conditions.wet: Reported to open rain or shine.
conditions.watering_prep: Owner waters and grooms with a dozer; listings say main and pee-wee tracks are groomed and watered.
conditions.seasonal: Open Wednesday afternoons and weekends. Hosts I4MX series rounds. Located inside a county park; the county threatened closure around 2020 (petition with ~7,700 signatures) but it remains open.

rider_reports.says: A local rider said he has ridden it many times and likes it while some friends do not; suggested checking videos first. Notes it is far west, essentially in the Everglades.
Magazine visit describes hard-packed hills and turns kept firm by constant watering and dozing; caters to all levels, rents bikes.
Two user ratings average 4.8, with terrain and watering scored 4.5 of 5 and jumps 5 of 5.

name: 74MX at the RKC

soil.notes: A rider-oriented roundup calls it classic southwest Florida sugar sand; directories mention sandy sections and a dedicated sand-turn practice track. Older RiderPlanet data lists some loose dirt and some sand.

layout.notes: Described as a legit SX/MX-style layout. Review summaries mention some awkward jump faces/landings and riders wanting bigger jumps on the main track. Mainly suited to beginner and intermediate riders.

conditions.dry: Sugar sand; expect loose, deep sections when dry.
conditions.watering_prep: Reported to be groomed several times a day, notably around midday, and regularly watered.
conditions.seasonal: Open Friday-Sunday. Check Facebook for weather calls. Quads share the property and can chew up bike lines.

rider_reports.says: One rider said not to bother with 74 because it had turned into a quad-focused track; another remembered it as a great track in the past.
Southeast track roundup: classic SW Florida sugar sand, well maintained, a legit SX/MX layout that challenges experienced riders.
Aggregated review summary: good watered soil, multiple tracks for each skill level, some awkward jumps, owners take pride in grooming; complaints about entry price and GPS leading onto back roads.

name: Florida Tracks & Trails
tracks_on_site: four Dream Traxx-built MX tracks (pee-wee, beginner, main lit track, hybrid/amateur)

soil.notes: Sources disagree: RiderPlanet says the MX tracks were clay and loam over a mostly hard-pack property, while a 2018 rider called it a sand track and another mentioned shell being thrown by side-by-sides. Trails were muddy sand when wet.

layout.notes: Many small and large jumps and many berms per RiderPlanet; professionally designed tracks.

conditions.wet: A 2015 visitor found the trails very wet and muddy, with deep muddy sand.
conditions.late_day: A 2018 rider said prep held up well all day.
conditions.watering_prep: Main track was watered and groomed.
conditions.seasonal: Closed; kept for the record. Riders should use MotoBros Punta Gorda (Piper Rd) or 74MX instead.

rider_reports.says: Riders said track quality had improved a lot, prep was great and held all day, and the sand track was a blast; one complained about quads and side-by-sides speeding and throwing shell near kids' areas.
Visitor riding the trail loop on an ATV found it soaked and muddy, getting stuck several times in muddy sand.
